title: Cabinet Cube DSL — Shape Spec
description: Each key is an axis; each value is a list of positions in [-1, 1] along that axis. Every position inserts one solid plane perpendicular to that axis, spanning the other two axes' full [-1, 1] range. An axis absent from the object means no planes on that axis (fully open). x = left(-1)/right(+1), y = bottom(-1)/top(+1), z = back(-1)/front(+1, nearest the viewer).
